title: DocPilot: Interactive Agent Orchestration and Training for Long Visual Document Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.21327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal long-document question answering requires models to seek sparse evidence across pages and modalities, understand heterogeneous document content, and reason over the collected evidence. Even advanced vision-language models (VLMs) can overlook sparse evidence and struggle with cross-modal reasoning in a single pass. Existing document agents further introduce multi-step interaction, but some still rely on predefined workflows or coarse-grained actions, limiting the flexibility and granularity of document reasoning. We introduce DocPilot, an agentic document framework that supports expressive orchestration and makes complex document solving learnable by small language models (SLMs). DocPilot orchestrates evidence seeking through page-level navigation and fine-grained evidence localization, and integrates local visual inspection, code-based numerical reasoning, and cross-modal reasoning for multimodal understanding. translated_title: DocPilot：面向长篇视觉文档理解的交互式智能体编排与训练
translated_abstract: 多模态长文档问答要求模型能够跨页面和跨模态寻找稀疏证据，理解异构的文档内容，并对收集到的证据进行推理。即使是先进的视觉语言模型（VLM），在单次处理中也容易遗漏稀疏证据，且难以完成跨模态推理。现有的文档智能体进一步引入了多步交互，但部分方法仍依赖预定义的工作流程或粗粒度的动作，限制了文档推理的灵活性和粒度。我们提出了DocPilot，这是一个智能体文档框架，支持富有表现力的编排能力，并使小型语言模型（SLM）能够学习解决复杂的文档任务。DocPilot通过页面级导航和细粒度证据定位来编排证据搜寻，并整合局部视觉检查、基于代码的数值推理以及跨模态推理，以实现多模态理解。
tldr: DocPilot是一个智能体文档框架，通过页面级导航、细粒度证据定位以及整合视觉检查、数值推理和跨模态推理的多模态编排，使小型语言模型能够有效学习并解决复杂的长篇视觉文档理解任务。
en_tdlr: DocPilot is an agentic document framework that orchestrates evidence seeking through page-level navigation, fine-grained evidence localization, and integrated visual, numerical, and cross-modal reasoning, enabling small language models to learnably solve complex long visual document understanding tasks.
